reference: User's annotated Chit image from this turn. The thin red guide was treated as markup and omitted from the outputs.

concepts.name: 01-compact-pebble
concepts.direction: Make the three colored fragments together read as one compact, softly rounded irregular triangular pebble. The blue becomes a shallower rounded lower-right wedge whose outer bottom curve gently continues the curve suggested by the red left edge and yellow right edge. Give the whole mark a stable, coherent footprint and eliminate the dangling low blue point. Match the existing organic shapes very closely.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
The latest attached image is the EDIT TARGET: Chit's approved crayon mark annotated by the user with a THIN RED GUIDE LOOP. The thin red outline/loop and tiny annotation dots are markup only. Remove ALL those annotations; do not incorporate the outline into the artwork. The actual artwork is three filled red/yellow/blue crayon pieces.
Keep the upper tomato-red piece on the left and golden-yellow piece at upper right unchanged as closely as possible: same size, orientation, placement, shapes, colors, diagonal crayon texture and paper flecks.
CHANGE THE LOWER BLUE PIECE: it currently protrudes too far downward and reads as a separate large triangle. Pull its bottom UP by roughly one quarter to one third of its existing height, and reshape it into a shallower, broader complementary lower segment. Tuck it close beneath the red and yellow. Its outside contour must complete ONE obvious, compact overall outer silhouette with the existing red and yellow edges. Its inside contour should accommodate the existing upper pieces across narrow clean transparent gaps. The three pieces should feel like fragments of one gently irregular pebble, not three stacked independent stones.
Use the user's thin red guide only to understand the more compact envelope, not as a line to trace or reproduce. No new bounding outline, enclosing frame, fourth shape, backing plate or background blob. Blue itself supplies the missing lower part of the shared shape.
Preserve authentic flat wax-crayon pigment, diagonal hand-scribbled texture, tiny pale flecks and gently rough outer edges. Three colors only: same tomato red, golden yellow and cobalt blue. No face, eyes, text, labels, plants, animals, shadows, gradients or 3D.
Output ONE avatar on the same square canvas with broad transparent margins and a genuinely transparent background. Keep it imperfect and hand-drawn. No black background fill.

The blue becomes a shallower rounded lower-right wedge whose outer bottom curve gently continues the curve suggested by the red left edge and yellow right edge. Give the whole mark a stable, coherent footprint and eliminate the dangling low blue point. Match the existing organic shapes very closely.

concepts.name: 02-soft-oval
concepts.direction: Aim for one slightly wide, tilted oval-like overall mass suggested by the outer edges of all three pieces. The blue becomes a low curved segment nestled at bottom right, with a gently curved bottom and a softly bulging right edge continuing from the yellow. Pull blue's lower edge up considerably; no huge blue base below the red. Do not force a perfect oval or modify the red and yellow to achieve symmetry.

concepts.name: 03-rounded-lozenge
concepts.direction: Aim for one soft, lopsided rounded diamond / lozenge silhouette for the three-piece cluster. Keep the existing upper red and yellow geometry. The blue is a compact broad-bottom wedge with only a very shallow rounded lower point, rather than a tall standalone triangle. Its lower-left edge visually joins the red's lower edge across a tiny gap and its right edge continues from yellow. Maintain very soft corners.

concepts.name: 04-cupped-base
concepts.direction: Make the existing red and yellow feel cradled by a shallow, solid blue curved base. Reshape blue into a short broad curved wedge with a slightly concave inner top-left edge fitting the red and a short gently rising right shoulder under yellow. Preserve narrow gaps. The outside edges of the three pieces together should suggest one squat rounded pebble or imperfect rounded square. Blue is one substantial filled piece, not an outline, smile, ring, thin crescent or bowl illustration.
